name: io.github.jschuller/mcp-server-servicenow
title: ServiceNow MCP Server
description: ServiceNow MCP server: Table API, CMDB, schema, aggregates, update sets and four Agent Skills.

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Auth type: basic (default), oauth, or api_key

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for basic auth or the OAuth password grant (omit for OAuth client credentials)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for basic auth or the OAuth password grant (omit for OAuth client credentials)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID (client credentials grant unless a username and password are set)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_API_KEY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header name for api_key auth (default x-sn-apikey, ServiceNow's default auth parameter)

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Hide write tools and refuse non-GET requests

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_ALLOW_JS_QUERIES
environmentVariables.description: Permit arbitrary javascript: in caller queries

environmentVariables.name: SERVICENOW_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Audit log target: stderr (default), off, or a file path
